items.title: Sebi proposes Rs 50,000 fine for firms not cooperating with monitors
items.description: Sebi has proposed a fine of ₹50,000 for each instance of non-cooperation by listed companies. Monitoring agencies would be empowered to submit reports directly to stock exchanges. Stricter enforcement measures may include freezing promoters' demat accounts. Companies are required to provide information to monitoring agencies within prescribed timelines. This initiative aims to ensure better accountability regarding the utilization of funds raised through public issues.

items.title: Pre-market action: Here's the trade setup for today's session
items.description: The Nifty index surged to close at 22,722, bouncing back with a hefty gain of 434 points from its lowest dip of the day. Positive remarks from Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman are likely to bolster investor confidence regarding the long-term capital gains tax. A decline in the India VIX suggests lower market anxiety, while foreign institutional investors recorded net sales, countered by robust domestic institutional purchases.

items.title: Stocks in news: Adani Enterprises, Hyundai Motor India, BHEL, BEL, Groww, Tata Elxsi and RailTel
items.description: Indian stocks rallied impressively, as benchmark indices surged by over 1.5%, fueled by a wave of positive investor sentiment. Key players like Adani Enterprises and Hyundai Motor India are capturing attention due to significant recent updates. While Tata Elxsi experienced a minor dip in net profit, revenue and EBIT improvements were encouraging. Furthermore, Bharat Electronics has secured fresh orders totaling Rs 533 crore, enhancing its order backlog.

items.title: GQG pares Rs 8,000 crore of Adani stakes in September quarter as FPI bets turn mixed
items.description: In a significant move, GQG Partners divested approximately ₹8,000 crore in stakes across five companies of the Adani Group during the September quarter. While some firms saw an uptick in foreign portfolio investments, others faced declines. The most substantial decrease was seen in Adani Energy Solutions, which dropped from 4.14% to 1.71%.

items.title: Sebi extends IPO size flexibility by six months to March 2027
items.description: In a significant regulatory update, Sebi has extended the timeline by six months for companies to adjust their issue sizes without the need for new approvals. This applies to initial public offerings set to commence by March 31, 2027. Lead managers are now permitted to modify offer documents to accommodate these size revisions, ensuring that the main objectives continue to be met.

items.title: Ircon to monetise 4 highway assets; PSU plans to unlock 3,000cr value as part of GoI's infra monetisation
items.description: Ircon International has placed four highway assets for sale in a government-led monetisation programme. These assets include toll-road and hybrid annuity model projects located in Madhya Pradesh, Rajasthan, Karnataka, and Gujarat. The enterprise value of the assets is estimated to be around ₹3,000 crore, as advised by Axis Capital. Currently, Ircon is a Navratna company primarily earning from its railway segment.
